prompt:
Goal: Create an elegant anime-style official fan club membership card for a fictional idol or character, with a luxurious platinum theme and a moody blue floral atmosphere.

Canvas: Horizontal rounded-corner card design, approximately 16:10 aspect ratio, full-bleed dark navy and icy blue palette. Add a thin double-line silver border around the entire card, subtle corner rounding, faint star accents, fine decorative arcs, and a premium printed-card look.

Layout: Split the card into two main areas. The left half shows a detailed anime portrait; the right half contains the membership information panel. At the top right, place the title text “OFFICIAL FAN CLUB” above a large serif “MEMBER CARD”, with thin horizontal divider lines and small star ornaments. In the upper-right corner, include a diamond-shaped platinum emblem with a star inside and the word “PLATINUM” beneath it. In the middle-right, place a pale silver rectangular information plate with clipped beveled corners and a thin metallic border. At the bottom right, add a white handwritten signature-like calligraphy flourish.

Subject details: The portrait is a beautiful young male anime character named Suzu, shown from the chest up, seated among blue-purple flower spikes. He has messy wavy black hair, pale skin, cool blue eyes, and a languid, melancholic expression. He wears a dark navy school-uniform-style blazer with gold buttons and a small crest on the chest, a white shirt, and a loose striped tie. He holds a lit cigarette near his lips with slender fingers; soft smoke curls upward into the blue night air. The background is a dreamy field of lavender-like blue flowers under cool moonlight, with shallow depth of field and cinematic lighting.

Text content: Use exactly 4 information rows inside the right information plate: 1) label “MEMBER NO.” with value 00001; 2) label “NAME” with value スズ; 3) label “RANK” with value PLATINUM; 4) Japanese label “有効期限” with value “無期限”. Keep typography elegant, mostly navy serif text on the pale panel. Preserve the Japanese text exactly where specified.

Visual style: High-detail Japanese anime illustration blended with premium graphic design, elegant serif typography, cool monochrome blue grading, silver foil-like linework, delicate floral engravings on the information plate, dreamy glow, crisp card UI composition, refined idol fan club merchandise aesthetic.

Constraints: Keep the card readable and balanced, with no extra rows beyond the 4 listed information rows. Do not add watermarks, QR codes, barcodes, logos, or unrelated text. Maintain the platinum luxury mood and the blue flower field setting.

promptZh:
目标：为虚构的偶像或角色创作一张优雅的动漫风格官方粉丝俱乐部会员卡，采用奢华的铂金主题和忧郁的蓝色花卉氛围。

画布：横向圆角卡片设计，比例约为 16:10，采用深海军蓝和冰蓝色全出血配色。在卡片四周添加细的双线银色边框、柔和的圆角处理、淡淡的星形装饰、精致的弧形装饰，呈现出高级印刷卡片的质感。

布局：将卡片分为两个主要区域。左侧展示精细的动漫肖像；右侧包含会员信息面板。在右上角，将标题文字“OFFICIAL FAN CLUB”置于大号衬线字体“MEMBER CARD”上方，并配以细水平分割线和小星形装饰。在右上角包含一个菱形铂金徽章，徽章内有星形图案，下方标注“PLATINUM”。在右侧中部，放置一个带有斜切角和细金属边框的浅银色矩形信息牌。在右下角，添加一个白色的手写书法签名装饰。

主体细节：肖像为一位美丽的年轻男性动漫角色，名为 Suzu，半身像，坐在一簇蓝紫色的花丛中。他有着凌乱的波浪状 black 头发，皮肤白皙，眼神冷峻，表情慵懒而忧郁。他身穿深海军蓝色的校服风格西装外套，带有金色纽扣和胸前的小徽章，内搭白衬衫，系着松散的条纹领带。他用修长的手指将点燃的香烟靠近嘴唇，柔和的烟雾在蓝色的夜空中袅袅上升。背景是月光下梦幻般的薰衣草色蓝色花田，具有浅景深和电影般的灯光效果。

文本内容：在右侧信息牌内使用 4 行信息：1) 标签“MEMBER NO.”，值为 00001；2) 标签“NAME”，值为 スズ；3) 标签“RANK”，值为 PLATINUM；4) 日文标签“有効期限”，值为“無期限”。保持排版优雅，浅色面板上主要使用海军蓝衬线字体。请务必保留指定的日文文本。

视觉风格：高细节日本动漫插画与高级平面设计相结合，优雅的衬线字体，冷色调单色蓝渐变，银箔质感的线条，信息牌上精致的花卉雕刻，梦幻般的光晕，清晰的卡片 UI 构图，精致的偶像粉丝俱乐部周边美学。

约束：保持卡片清晰易读且布局平衡，除列出的 4 行信息外，不要添加额外的行。不要添加水印、二维码、条形码、Logo 或无关文本。保持铂金奢华氛围和蓝色花田背景。
